intent: REFACTOR TelemetrySampleEvent: inspect the implementation for layering violations, blocking calls, unbounded buffers, hardcoded values and invariant gaps; improve clarity without changing the public surface or breaking tests. Spec: Telemetry Intake & Validation (publishes TelemetrySampleValidated / TelemetrySampleValidationFailed) and the downstream contexts: shared kernel event record in package com.pulsestream.telemetry.shared.events (no domain types of any context). Immutable record TelemetrySampleEvent(String deviceId, String metric, double value, Instant tDevice, Instant tIngress, String validationStatus). Constants VALID="VALID" and VALIDATION_FAILED="VALIDATION_FAILED". Compact constructor rejects null/blank deviceId, metric, null tDevice/tIngress, and a validationStatus that is neither constant (NullPointerException/IllegalArgumentException). Method boolean isValidationFailed(). Ordering key is tDevice, never tIngress. Used as the payload of TelemetrySampleValidated, ValidationFailed and TelemetrySampleSequenced events.
